localAgencies.name: Jefferson County Department of Health, Air & Radiation Protection
localAgencies.notes: Issues construction, operating, and Title V permits in Jefferson County per EPA's Alabama permitting page.

localAgencies.name: City of Huntsville Natural Resources & Environmental Management

overview: ADEM's Air Division issues minor source construction permits, PSD and nonattainment NSR permits, Synthetic Minor Operating Permits (SMOP), and Title V Major Source Operating Permits (MSOP) statewide, except where Jefferson County and the City of Huntsville run local permit programs. ADEM has not established a list of exempt source types or sizes; the need for a permit is decided case by case.

permitTypes.name: No general exemption list
permitTypes.description: ADEM states it has not established a list of source types or sizes that are exempt from permitting; permit necessity is determined case by case. Title V trivial and insignificant activity lists apply only at major sources.

permitTypes.name: Air Permit (Minor Source)
permitTypes.description: Construction/operating permit for minor sources. Does not expire.

permitTypes.name: Synthetic Minor Operating Permit (SMOP)
permitTypes.description: Operating permit with enforceable limits that keep a source below major source thresholds. Does not expire.

permitTypes.name: Air Permit (NSR/PSD)
permitTypes.description: For projects that are major sources by themselves or exceed significance levels at existing major sources in attainment areas. Requires BACT and ambient air quality modeling.

permitTypes.name: Nonattainment NSR
permitTypes.description: For major projects in nonattainment areas. Requires LAER and emission offsets.

permitTypes.name: Major Source Operating Permit (MSOP)
permitTypes.description: Title V permit consolidating applicable requirements for major sources into one document. Five-year renewable term; ADEM states there are no permit fees for MSOP issuance.

permitTypes.name: Gasoline Transporter Air Permit
permitTypes.description: Permit does not expire, but the Air Sticker must be renewed annually.

oilAndGas.summary: ADEM's air permitting page lists no oil-and-gas-specific air permit. Oil and gas facilities use the standard minor source, SMOP, PSD, or MSOP paths; federal NSPS (40 CFR 60 Subparts OOOO/OOOOa/OOOOb) and NESHAP (40 CFR 63 Subpart HH) apply where applicable.
